decision.observation: COPPER ORE tooltip confirmed: Metal Ore, 334.2 kg, 21.6°C at approximately x=0.80, y=0.62. This is enough for the Oxygen Diffuser (needs 200 kg Metal Ore). The deposit is in the right-side wall. Oxylite 79.7 kg, Sandstone 6.4 t. Resources panel only shows 2 categories (Oxylite, Sandstone) so the Copper Ore is undig. Warnings: 'Building lacks resources', 'No Oxygen Generator built', 'Colony requires a food source'.
decision.hypothesis: Pressing G to activate the Dig tool then dragging over the Copper Ore tiles will queue dupes to mine it. Once collected (334.2 kg), the Oxygen Diffuser (200 kg Metal Ore) can be built. 334 kg is not enough for the Research Station (400 kg) but enough for the Diffuser.
decision.memory: CONFIRMED: Copper Ore at (0.80, 0.62) = Metal Ore 334.2 kg. Enough for Oxygen Diffuser (200 kg). The deposit appears to be 2-3 tiles. After digging, build Oxygen Diffuser. Still need Algae (found in lower cave) and Power for the Diffuser. Dig tool = G key.
